task_name: World 117 Task A  -  Cash Flow Intra-Operating Clearing Conservation & Zero-Net Equity SBC Audit
prompt: Review the MedTech source journals in medtech_oct2026_close_workbook_controls.xlsx. Reconstruct noncash financing and stock compensation, distinguish working-capital clearing from phantom cash activity, and state which source packets warrant exclusion without erasing genuine compensation.

rubric.description: Preserves the -$15,000.00 prepaid and +$15,000.00 card operating reconciliation effects; combined cash effect is $0.00.
Derives October compensation $33,310.14 and YTD compensation $888,590.41 from the compensation journals.
Eliminates the $770.00 phantom non-cash equity add-back and -$770.00 Common Stock financing offset caused by a same-month reversed compound entry.
Explains that intra-section Operating balance-sheet clearings (such as credit card payment clearing into AmEx and Prepaid Expenses) must not be stripped as cross-section non-cash reclassifications.
Excludes the balanced no-cash financing packet without account-period netting that could erase genuine compensation in another journal.
